subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 16, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - August 16, 2026**

**Breaking News:**

Python Packaging Council Candidates Announced

The Python Software Foundation (PSF) has announced the candidates for the Python Packaging Council election. This is a significant development for the Python community, and we're excited to see the impact it will have on the packaging ecosystem. As a community-driven Linux distribution, AcreetionOS relies heavily on Python and its packaging tools, so this news is particularly relevant to us.

**Community News:**

* Our community has been busy with various activities, including adding a welcome message for first-time contributors to our CI/CD pipeline and re-triggering the GitLab mirror to ensure our codebase stays up-to-date.
* Security updates have been issued by AlmaLinux and Debian, which we've incorporated into our distribution to ensure our users have the latest security patches.

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can customize your AcreetionOS experience by using the AUR (Arch User Repository) sidebar toggle? This feature allows you to easily manage your packages and dependencies. To access it, simply navigate to the Acreetion AppStore and toggle the AUR sidebar. From there, you can browse and install packages from the Arch community.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community!
